$comment: 听力训练营 L30（P-L3 续跑，阶段三第十课，L26-L30 委婉表达段末课）。脚本 100% 原创；Part 3 委婉表达（A dog is OK, but… / He's OK, but… / Fish are OK, but… / I'm not sure；一段长对话 5 题：觉得养狗怎么样 / 对自己的兔子什么感受 / 为什么不能养猫 / 觉得养鱼怎么样 / 对帮忙照看兔子什么态度；其中「像看没声音的电视」需要推断=无聊）+ Part 5 匹配含「先选 A 后改 B」（Nora 告诉爸爸五个同学各养什么宠物，8 种动物 A-H 全部被提到，3 个是干扰）。词汇 ≥95% 落在 KET A2 词表，超出的词进 warmup。语速 1.0x。
title: Choosing a Pet
intro: 先听 Nora 和 Finn 聊养宠物：狗太麻烦？兔子好不好玩？为什么不能养猫？鱼怎么样？说话人常用「is OK, but…」「I'm not sure」这样的委婉说法，真正的意思在后面；有一题说「看鱼像看没声音的电视」，要自己想一想这是什么意思。再听 Nora 告诉爸爸五个同学各养什么宠物——有人先养过一种后来换了，要听「现在养的是什么」。8 种动物都会被提到，有 3 种没人养。

sections.intro: 听 Nora 和 Finn 聊养什么宠物。五道题问的是看法、感受和理由，注意「is OK, but…」「I'm not sure」后面才是真正的意思；有一句要靠上下文推断。

script.text: Finn, your mum said you can have a pet at last! What are you going to get? You always said you wanted a big dog.
When I was six! A dog is OK, but you have to walk it twice a day, in the rain too. Dad says dogs are noisy, but that's not it. It's just a lot of work. I'd like a cat. Cats look after themselves.
That's true. I wish my rabbit could do that.
Don't you like him? Your sister says he's the best pet in the world.
He's OK, but he isn't much fun. He just sits in the garden and eats all day. My little sister loves him, and that's fine. But I'd like a pet I can play with.
Then get a dog!
Maybe one day. So, a cat for you. Doesn't your mum hate cats?
No, she loves them, and she says they're cheap to keep. The money isn't a problem. It's my brother. When a cat comes near him, his eyes go red and he feels ill. So no cat.
Oh no. What about fish? My cousin has ten.
Well, what do you think of fish?
Fish are OK, but you can't hold them. They're pretty to look at, and they don't cost much. But watching them is like watching TV with no sound. Nothing happens.
Very funny. OK, I'll think about a bird, then.
Good. Now, can you look after my rabbit next week? We're going to my grandmother's for five days.
I'm not sure. I'm happy to help, and I've got a lot of homework, but that's not the problem. I'm worried I'll forget to feed him. I forget everything.
I'll send you a message every morning. He only needs some green food and water.

questions.q: What does Finn think about getting a dog?
options: He would like a very big one.
questions.explain: A dog is OK, but you have to walk it twice a day… It's just a lot of work——「is OK, but」后面是真心话：太麻烦。「吵」是爸爸说的，他说 that's not it；「想要大狗」是六岁时候的事。

questions.q: How does Nora feel about her rabbit?
options: She thinks he eats too much.
She would like a pet that plays more.
questions.explain: He's OK, but he isn't much fun… I'd like a pet I can play with——「He's OK, but」= 不太满意，想要能一起玩的宠物。「爱他」的是妹妹；「吃」只是描述他整天坐着吃，没说吃太多。

questions.q: Why can't Finn have a cat?
options: Cats cost too much to keep.
His brother gets ill near cats.
questions.explain: When a cat comes near him, his eyes go red and he feels ill——哥哥对猫过敏。「贵」不对，妈妈说 cheap to keep；「妈妈讨厌猫」是 Nora 问的，Finn 说 she loves them。

questions.q: What does Nora think about fish?
questions.explain: watching them is like watching TV with no sound. Nothing happens——「像看没声音的电视，什么都不发生」= 无聊，要靠推断。「漂亮」「便宜」都是 but 前面的客气话。

questions.q: How does Finn feel about looking after Nora's rabbit?
options: He is happy to do it.
He is worried he might forget to feed it.
questions.explain: I'm not sure… I'm worried I'll forget to feed him——担心忘了喂。「乐意帮」是客气话；「作业多」他说 that's not the problem。

sections.intro: 听 Nora 告诉爸爸五个同学各养什么宠物。把每个人和右边 A-H 的动物配起来。有人先养过一种后来换了，要听「现在养的是什么」。8 种动物都会被提到，有 3 种没人养。

script.text: Nora, your teacher wants everyone to bring a photo of their pet on Friday. Does everyone in your class have one?
Most people. I'll take a photo of the rabbit. Ella wanted a dog for years, but their flat is too small, so last month she got a cat. It sleeps on her bed.
Clever. And Oscar? I remember he had a mouse.
He did, but it ran away, and his mum said no more mice. So now he has a snake! It's small and green, and it only eats once a week.
A snake! I hope he doesn't bring it to school. What about Ruby?
Ruby lives on a farm, so she has a horse. She rides it every morning before school.
Lucky girl. And Sam?
Sam has fish. Six of them, in a big glass box in the living room. He says they're easy.
They are. And your friend Lucy?
Lucy has a bird. It talks! It says hello when you come in and goodbye when you leave.
I'd like to meet that bird. Now go and find the rabbit for your photo.

questions.explain: Ella wanted a dog for years, but their flat is too small, so last month she got a cat——想要狗，最后养的是猫。
he had a mouse… but it ran away… So now he has a snake——以前养老鼠，现在养蛇。
Ruby lives on a farm, so she has a horse——住农场，养马。
Sam has fish. Six of them——养了六条鱼。
Lucy has a bird. It talks!——会说话的鸟。狗、老鼠是干扰，兔子是 Nora 自己的。
